name: Forgejo
longDescription:
Forgejo is a lightweight, community-driven Git forge: host repositories, review pull requests, track issues, publish packages and run CI with Forgejo Actions. It is written in Go, fast and easy to maintain.

This app installs the Forgejo 17 release line (the official Cosmos market ships Forgejo 11). It uses the built-in SQLite database, so no extra database container is needed. The image follows the 17 tag and receives 17.x patch releases through auto-update.

Finish the setup page on first visit. The first account registered becomes the administrator. Git over SSH is published on the host port chosen at install (222 by default).
description: Self-hosted Git forge with pull requests, issues, packages and CI (Forgejo 17 release line, SQLite built in)
